_comment: Offline kernel-facts fixture for the S10+ beta baseline. Every value here is either (a) taken from a real artefact committed in this repository, named in 'provenance', or (b) explicitly marked unverified. It exists so the security auditor and the permission tooling can run OFFLINE and never fabricate a device reading. Do not add a value that has no provenance.

provenance.release: docs/s10plus-autonomous-boot-repair/evidence-a27/last_kmsg.txt: '<0>[ 2910.828571] I[7: nuxel-ui: 5341] linux_banner: Linux version 4.14.253 (root@) (gcc version 15.3.1 ...)'
provenance.kernel_config_source: docs/s10plus-autonomous-boot-repair/UTM-LAUNCHER-PORT/A29-PORT-RECORD.md: '/proc/config.gz: # CONFIG_DRM is not set' - /proc/config.gz is readable on the handset
provenance.audit: evidence-a27/last_kmsg.txt contains a live 'kauditd' thread -> the audit subsystem is enabled
provenance.dr: docs/s10plus-autonomous-boot-repair/BOOT-STAGES.md: '# CONFIG_DRM is not set' -> no /dev/dri, no KMS (fbdev only)

unverified: apparmor: not yet read from /sys/kernel/security/lsm on the handset
notes: CONFIG_BPF_LSM is not set: systemd reports 'bpf-restrict-fs: BPF LSM hook not enabled' and proceeds without device ACLs.
CONFIG_DRM is not set: no KMS, no /dev/dri, fbdev only -> no Wayland compositor output, so no system-wide clipboard to mediate.

Landlock (>= 5.13), kernel lockdown (>= 4.17), BPF LSM (>= 5.7), arm64 CFI (>= 5.13), Shadow Call Stack (>= 5.7), BTI and Pointer Authentication (ARMv8.5/8.3 hardware) are all unavailable on 4.14.253 / Exynos 9820 (ARMv8.2-A).
nftables 'socket cgroupv2' matching requires Linux >= 5.13; on this kernel per-app network matching must use cgroup v1 net_cls classid.
